topic: Output-sensitive exact-once enumeration of distinct coefficient tuples for the component-aligned Gaussian LiMVAM calibration frontier. This is a new attempt at parent eid_limvam_calibration_frontier: replace its failed completed-path quotient and unavailable child oracle by accumulated immutable original-label regression rows. Build and prune the 2^p removed-set compatibility DAG, intern exact edge rows, merge identical fragments at each removed set, prove the live-fragment right congruence and projection-to-output bound, and emit Theta_G(O_G) once per numerical tuple with common union-support ancestry in O(poly(p,m) 2^p max{1,N_out}) ordered-exact-real time and space. Keep the parent's model-valid arbitrary-pairing scope and reuse its covariance-region inference only; do not claim unrestricted LiMVAM, polynomial-delay, off-model nonchordal preprocessing, or continuum-region enumeration. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolver derived the immutable row formula b(A,r)=Sigma[r,A]Sigma[A,A]^-1, proved that after source-to-sink pruning equal fragments at fixed A have identical completion sets and unequal fragments are completion-disjoint, and charged each bucket to at most N_out sink tuples. Deterministic exact row interning and integer-fragment tries avoid a real-hash oracle. The nonzero p=3 witness has exactly orders 123,132,213 and one tuple; exact checks passed 28 further cases and 654 permutations, including 24 orders collapsing to one tuple. Checks addressed Schur-slope confusion, dead prefixes, late collisions, empty graphs/outputs, exact equality, singular boundaries, and the off-model nonchordal obstruction. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Fully verify the composition of arbitrary-graph q-path exactness with coordinate-noise positive-definite completion on maintained-model inputs; no model-specific algebraic lemma otherwise remains open informally. EARLY KILL TEST: Independently implement rational p<=4 exhaustive order comparison, requiring every merged prefix completion set and every bucket bound to match; any mismatch stops the run instead of reverting to order enumeration. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/eid_limvam_fragment_hashcons_enumeration.md.

open_problems.open_problem: Prove that immutable original-label regression-row fragments give exact-once, output-sensitive enumeration of the distinct component-aligned Gaussian LiMVAM coefficient tuples represented by the removed-set compatibility DAG.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The parent proved a path-independent 2^p removed-set feasibility DAG, but its completed-path quotient canonicalizes an inducing order only after a full tuple has been reached, and its child oracle presupposes the ability to find quotient children without enumerating their paths. The literature instead quotients graphical outputs or total-effect functionals using graphical signatures. LiMVAM tuple equality is covariance-dependent: zero coefficients and commuting removable roots can make factorially many paths induce one tuple, including collisions exposed only after later removals. The first changed proof step is to attach the immutable original-label row b(A,r) to every transition and prove that equality of live fragments at fixed A is a right congruence while unequal fragments have disjoint completion sets.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A sound and complete deterministic algorithm that interns exact edge rows, merges live fragments at each removed set, emits every tuple in Theta_G(O_G) exactly once with common union-support ancestry, and runs in O(poly(p,m) 2^p max{1,N_out}) ordered-exact-real time and space.

writing_exemplar.why: Its framing cleanly separates enumeration of structural representatives from minimal enumeration of distinct causal outputs.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: many compatible structures encode repeated causal answers -> per-structure enumeration duplicates outputs -> quotient by the target functional -> enumerate each LiMVAM coefficient tuple once

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt its recursive partition into maximal subclasses on which a causal output is fixed, replacing graphical effect signatures by immutable regression-row fragments and proving completeness and minimality.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both problems quotient many structural witnesses by equality of a causal functional, but LiMVAM equality is numerical and row-based.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt its connected-prefix branch-disjointness and exact-once traversal analysis to live fragment classes of the removed-set DAG.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Its proof charges work to distinct DAG completions; the new proof must establish analogous disjointness and charge work to distinct numerical tuples.

method_exemplars.technique: Reuse recursive residual root removal and one-step FGLS coefficient-row estimation after the population tuple frontier is enumerated.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the source model's regression-row semantics and the natural estimator and limit-theory rung for each identified branch.

open_problems.open_problem: Compose arbitrary-view-graph removable-root q-path exactness with coordinatewise positive-definite disturbance completion on maintained-model inputs.

source_refs.excerpt: Path independence is the step that replaces factorial order search by a memoized subset-state representation.
separates edgewise component alignment from the genuinely global positive-definite completion obstruction.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The parent separately established removed-set path independence and an arbitrary-view-graph fixed-order criterion combining observed-edge residual diagonality with coordinatewise positive-definite completion. The new q-DAG proof proposes to omit prefix completion tests on maintained-model inputs by borrowing one generating full covariance as an existence witness, but it has not yet been checked that the extracted coordinate principal blocks agree with every specified residual entry for every candidate order and that independently assembling those blocks preserves all observed covariances. The first changed proof step is therefore the induction from q-valid source-to-sink paths to model-valid completions, not the already-proved row formula or fragment congruence.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A necessary-and-sufficient theorem identifying model-valid arbitrary-graph coefficient tuples with the sink projections of precisely the q-valid immutable-row fragments, with a positive-definite coordinate-noise certificate for every emitted tuple and a regime-stated counterexample outside maintained-model inputs.

writing_exemplar.why: Mirror its progression from Gaussian ambiguity to cross-view residual information, with an arbitrary pairing graph as the proof-breaking data regime.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: single-view Gaussian structure is ambiguous -> paired residuals constrain a shared order -> arbitrary pairing reveals partial disturbance covariances -> compose recursive compatibility with global completion

method_exemplars.technique: Carry coordinatewise positive-definite completion through the residual reduction, using clique completion for chordal patterns and an explicit global feasibility certificate otherwise.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The extra model-validity condition is exactly completion of a partially specified disturbance covariance for each coordinate.

method_exemplars.technique: Transfer recursive Schur-update perturbation bounds and margin-based vertex decisions to the graph-completion-aware fragment recursion.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both analyses control accumulated second-moment error across recursively reduced Gaussian SEM states, supplying the closest inference rung once population composition is proved.

open_problems.open_problem: Classify the computational complexity of finding a minimum set of calibrated views that preserves the full component-aligned LiMVAM coefficient-tuple set without enumerating all compatible orders.

source_refs.excerpt: proving a hardness or approximation result for the induced-view hitting problem

open_problems.why_unsolved: The parent gives a residual-witness hitting characterization but computes it by exhaustive subset and compatible-path enumeration. Numerical duplicates make order-level witnesses insufficient: an excluded order can share its coefficient tuple with a surviving order, so the acquisition design must preserve tuples rather than structural witnesses. The first changed proof step is to compile separation certificates from quotient fragments directly into a view-pair hypergraph and prove that hitting those certificates is equivalent to tuple-set preservation before any hardness reduction or approximation argument applies.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A quotient-aware necessary-and-sufficient hitting characterization with either an exact fixed-parameter algorithm for minimum calibration or an NP-hardness theorem and a proved approximation guarantee, including efficiently checkable sufficiency and minimality certificates.

writing_exemplar.why: Mirror its conversion of causal information acquisition into a cost-aware separation problem with an explicit computational frontier.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: full causal identification requires separating alternatives -> acquiring every information source is costly -> design becomes a covering problem -> optimize passive LiMVAM calibration over tuple-distinguishing witnesses

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt the proof that a minimum family of separating intervention targets is necessary and sufficient for full identification.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Both problems choose a smallest acquisition design that separates every observationally compatible causal alternative.

method_exemplars.technique: Adapt its covering reduction, hardness proof, and approximation analysis to quotient-level residual witnesses.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the nearest design-complexity machinery once tuple preservation is compiled into a valid hitting instance.

method_exemplars.technique: Transfer finite-sample separation analysis to show when empirical residual witnesses preserve the population-optimal calibration design.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The empirical design remains valid only when estimated second moments reliably separate the relevant Gaussian structural alternatives.

open_problems.open_problem: Determine the bit complexity of exact-once LiMVAM tuple enumeration for rational covariance inputs, including coefficient and certificate encoding growth under immutable-row interning.

source_refs.excerpt: The 2^p-state result counts exact-real arithmetic operations and does not by itself give polynomial bit complexity.

open_problems.why_unsolved: The ordered exact-real bound counts arithmetic and equality tests at unit cost, hiding numerator and denominator growth in the principal-submatrix inverses defining b(A,r), the encoding size of exact row keys, and the size of positive-definite completion certificates. A polynomial arithmetic count therefore need not yield a polynomial-bit procedure. The first changed proof step is to replace each inverse and Schur update by a fraction-free determinant or elimination representation and bound intermediate and output bit lengths uniformly over all 2^p states.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: For rational covariance inputs of bit length L, either a deterministic exact enumerator with total bit complexity polynomial in p, m, L, 2^p, N_out, and emitted encoding length, or a matching lower bound showing unavoidable superpolynomial intermediate or certificate growth.

writing_exemplar.why: Its projected-enumeration framing makes the input representation, projected output count, and delay or total-cost model explicit.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: compact witnesses project to fewer outputs -> output-sensitive enumeration avoids repeated witnesses -> arithmetic representations can still grow -> state a bit-complexity frontier for exact regression-row outputs

method_exemplars.technique: Use fraction-free Gaussian elimination and Sylvester-identity divisibility to compute regression rows and Schur complements while controlling integer growth.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Every immutable row is an exact rational linear-system solution from a principal covariance submatrix, precisely the computation fraction-free elimination controls.

literature_map:
Heurtebise et al. (ICML 2026, arXiv:2502.20115) introduce LiMVAM, prove covariance-based identification under paired-view diversity, and distinguish partial-order recovery from uniqueness of a total permutation.
Their recursive-residual proof removes a common root, preserves model form, and estimates coefficient rows by one-step FGLS; it does not enumerate a duplicate-free calibration frontier.
Shimizu et al. (JMLR 2006) establish LiNGAM identification from non-Gaussian disturbances; Shimizu et al. (JMLR 2011) supply the recursive DirectLiNGAM ancestor of LiMVAM removal.
Richard et al. (NeurIPS 2021, arXiv:2110.13502) identify Gaussian shared components through view-specific noise diversity, supplying component-alignment and joint-diagonalization context.
Ghassami et al. (NeurIPS 2018) orient unpaired multi-domain systems through mechanism changes or invariances, showing that loss of pairing requires assumptions different from LiMVAM cross-view correlation.
Guo and Perkovic (AISTATS 2021, arXiv:2010.08611) minimally enumerate distinct total-effect functionals over an MPDAG and explicitly separate structural representatives from causal outputs.
Wienobst et al. (AAAI 2023, arXiv:2301.12212) enumerate every DAG in a CPDAG or MPDAG exactly once with linear delay, but charge complexity to DAG count rather than projected numerical-tuple count.
Pruesse and Ruskey (SIAM J. Comput. 1994, DOI:10.1137/S0097539791202647) enumerate linear extensions in constant amortized time, still scaling with the number of orders.
Deep, Hu, and Koutris (ICDT 2021, arXiv:2101.03712) show that projection changes enumeration complexity because many full witnesses can map to one output.
Wang, Kolar, and Drton (JASA 2026, arXiv:2305.14506) construct confidence sets for causal orders and propagated effect intervals, but not inference for a tuple quotient whose cardinality changes at collisions.
Boege et al. (JRSSB 2026, DOI:10.1093/jrsssb/qkaf068) use rational Gaussian-DAG parameterizations and polynomial constraints, offering algebraic tools for regression-row collision fibers.
Grone et al. (Linear Algebra Appl. 1984, DOI:10.1016/0024-3795(84)90207-6) locate the chordal boundary for local positive-definite completion; nonchordal patterns require global value-dependent constraints.
No scanned paper occupies the exact target-method pair: exact-once, output-size-sensitive enumeration of distinct LiMVAM coefficient tuples from a 2^p removed-set quotient with exact regression-row equality.
prior_proposal_map:
The highest-priority source was the downgraded parent eid_limvam_calibration_frontier/v1; its README, proto core, writeup, solve record, five angle reviews, and terminal general/math/rubric reviews were inspected.
The parent has no archived rejected-angle core; its banked failure is the missing duplicate-free output-sensitive tuple enumerator, with the completed-path quotient and child oracle explicitly rejected as circular.
The parent writeup separately proves removed-set q-path exactness and arbitrary-view-graph positive-definite completion, exposing the composition boundary named by the child run.
Reviewer angle0_v2.json supplies the minimum-calibration hardness and approximation direction; angle0_v5.json also records weakened-component-alignment and exceptional-locus testing directions, which were lower priority for this maintained-scope run.
The accepted eid_lingam_direction_min_order_v1_truncated_cumulant_minimality core and rejected angle were inspected for shared-order and exact-arithmetic boundaries but yielded no closer enumeration opportunity.
The downgraded eid_blocked_colour_reversal_complete_v1 writeup and reviews were inspected: its canonical PDAG lift solves exact-once state enumeration but leaves symbolic rational-effect quotienting open.
Rejected SCORE-order cores were inspected for boundary and minimax analogues; they do not provide a closer maintained-model enumeration construction.
The parent gaps map also points to pid_multivalued_iv_vertex_calculus_v1 and eid_robust_backshift_uniform_distance_v1 as analogous child-generation and design-certificate failures, but neither is as direct as the parent evidence.
